title: Reuse a proven Sora 2 prompt in Seedance 2.0 to generate not...
content: Reuse a proven Sora 2 prompt in Seedance 2.0 to generate not just visuals but also music, sound effects, and the cut/edit/camera work directly from the model, then apply only final video filters in CapCut for post-processing.
description:
Seedance 2.0 via @yapper_so 

Using my previous Sora 2 prompt, all the audio, including music, sound effects, and cut, edit, and camera work, comes directly from the model. I only applied filters to the video using CapCut. https://t.co/q4OabNT3II
